title: Mohammad Adil Shah begins his reign
text: Start of the 1627-1656 reign of the Adil Shahi ruler at Bijapur.

title: Traditional birth year of Shivaji
text: Many modern accounts give 1630; others give 1627.

title: Torna traditionally acquired
text: Often dated c. 1646-47. Date and manner (force or arrangement) vary.

title: Death of Dadoji Konddev
text: Usually stated as c. 1647. He is associated with the early administration of the Pune jagir.

title: Purandar and the Shahaji crisis
text: Traditional accounts place Purandar's acquisition and a crisis between Bijapur and Shahaji around 1648-49. Sequence and causes are disputed.

title: Settlement over Shahaji
text: A settlement is said to have ended the crisis; one tradition links it to Kondana's return. Disputed.

title: Javli acquired; Raigad becomes the seat
text: Traditionally dated 1656. Pratapgad is built nearby in the following years.

title: Death of Mohammad Adil Shah
text: End of the 1627-1656 reign at Bijapur.

title: Northern Konkan around Kalyan taken
text: Traditionally dated 1657.

title: Afzal Khan's expedition; events at Pratapgad
text: The expedition is well attested. The November 1659 events are heavily shaped by later tradition and differ between accounts.

title: Panhala taken (traditional)
text: Traditional accounts say Panhala passed to Shivaji in late 1659.

title: Siddi Jauhar's siege of Panhala
text: Followed by Shivaji's escape from the fort. Details and dates vary.

title: Mughal siege of Chakan
text: Chakan was besieged by Mughal forces and defended by Firangoji Narsala.

title: Coronation at Raigad
text: Shivaji's formal coronation, outside the scope of this version.

title: Shahu begins his reign
text: Chhatrapati Shahu's reign is dated 1707-1749.

title: Baji Rao I becomes Peshwa
text: He holds the office until his death in 1740.

title: Nizam-ul-Mulk's autonomous Deccan rule
text: Usually dated from his victory at Shakar Kheda in 1724.

title: Battle of Palkhed
text: February 1728: Baji Rao I forces terms on the Nizam; Treaty of Mungi-Shevgaon follows.

title: Baji Rao I near Delhi
text: Traditional date for his raid to the outskirts of Delhi.

title: Bhopal and the settlement of Malwa
text: January 1738 settlement (Doraha) after the Bhopal campaign; Malwa passes to the Marathas.

title: Death of Baji Rao I
text: April 1740.

title: Death of Shahu
text: End of the 1707-1749 reign.

title: Third Battle of Panipat
text: 14 January 1761: a major Maratha defeat by an Afghan-led coalition. Not a playable campaign in this version.

title: First Anglo-Maratha War begins
text: Ends with the Treaty of Salbai in 1782.

title: Second Anglo-Maratha War
text: Includes Assaye (23 September 1803). Not a playable campaign in this version.

title: Third Anglo-Maratha War begins
text: Clash at Khadki on 5 November; Pune occupied; fighting at Sitabuldi (Nagpur) in November; Mahidpur on 21 December.

title: Koregaon Bhima
text: 1 January 1818. Interpreted in different ways.

title: Ashti and the fall of the forts
text: Bapu Gokhale is killed at Ashti in February; Company forces take the hill forts through 1818.

title: Baji Rao II surrenders
text: June 1818. The Peshwa's office is ended.
